title: Extremes of Gaussian fields with a product term in the variance
summary: We study the high excursion probability of a centered Gaussian field on a square. Writing \(σ\) and \(r\) for its standard deviation and correlation function, we assume that \(σ\) has a unique maximum at the corner \(\boldsymbol{0}=(0,0)\) and \[ 1-σ(\boldsymbol{t}) \sim t_1^β+t_2^β+t_1^a t_2^a , \qquad \boldsymbol{t}=(t_1,t_2)\to\boldsymbol{0} \] in \(\mathbb R_+^2\). The local correlation is assumed to satisfy \[ 1-r(\boldsymbol{t},\boldsymbol{s})\sim |t_1-s_1|^α+|t_2-s_2|^α, \qquad 0<α<β. \] This product form of the standard-deviation loss is not covered by the usual locally additive…
